name: cognee-memory
description: A real knowledge graph engine under the Werkbank sample data: Cognee (Apache-2.0, topoteretes/cognee) turns text into entities and relations and answers questions over them. Runs on this computer through the published cognee-mcp package (needs uv; the first start downloads about 1 GB). Load the sample data once with npm run cognee:seed.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store text or documents in Cognee memory. Without a session it becomes permanent graph memory (entities and relations are extracted); with a session id it only goes to the fast session cache.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Ask Cognee a question. It searches the graph, the vectors and the session memory and returns the matching facts or an answer.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete one dataset or everything this connector owns from Cognee memory. Irreversible.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key
llm_api_key.description: Key of the model provider Cognee uses to extract entities and answer questions (OpenAI by default; see the Cognee .env template for other providers). The text you store is sent to that provider. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.

memory_folder.title: Memory folder
memory_folder.description: Absolute path of a folder on this computer where Cognee keeps its databases, for example /Users/you/cognee-memory. Use the same folder when you run npm run cognee:seed.
